messages:
maria: heads up - sample onboarding flow is double-posting uploads when the emulator network toggles. saw two identical POSTs in customer repro.
kevin: is that the streaming RequestBody we added for progress?
maria: yep. Retrofit + OkHttp streaming body. If the socket times out, OkHttp sometimes retries and we get a second upload.
anya: are we using retryOnConnectionFailure? that will cause retries on some failures.
kevin: default client has retryOnConnectionFailure=true. works for idempotent calls but not file uploads.
sam: quick repro: start upload on emulator, flip airplane mode for ~2s, flip back. server logs show POST, failure, then second POST.
maria: sample logs: ```
I/okhttp: --> POST https://api.redwood.local/v1/upload
I/okhttp: --> END POST (streamed)
I/okhttp: <-- HTTP FAILED: java.net.SocketTimeoutException: timeout
I/okhttp: --> POST https://api.redwood.local/v1/upload
I/okhttp: --> END POST (streamed)
```
anya: ok. OkHttp marks streamed bodies as "(streamed)" and can't replay them. But it may still try reconnecting under some conditions.
kevin: fixes: 1) change sample client to disable retryOnConnectionFailure for upload client; 2) SDK-level: detect non-repeatable bodies and avoid transparent retries.
maria: SDK idea: detect contentLength()==-1 or a OneShot marker on RequestBody, then tag request and skip auto-retry in dispatcher.
kevin: pseudo: ```kotlin
val client = OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .retryOnConnectionFailure(true)
  .addInterceptor { chain ->
    val req = chain.request()
    if (isNonRepeatable(req.body)) req = req.newBuilder().tag(OneShot::class.java, OneShot()).build()
    chain.proceed(req)
  }
  .build()
// retry policy checks request.tag(OneShot::class.java) and skips retries
```
sam: add an integration test that toggles emulator network and asserts only one POST received.
anya: also treat multipart as non-repeatable if any part is streamed. conservative approach.
maria: I'll open PRs: one for sample immediate fix, one for SDK change and docs. linking GH issue numbers in the PR.
ci-bot: CI started for branch fix/upload-retry-196999 (build 4890).
maria: assigning to self, will include repro script and logs in PR.
kevin: add a note in quickstart: "disable retries for one-shot streaming uploads or implement server-side dedupe."
